svg.text: a method's road from the interpreter to C2, and what each form of it records
type checks go into the profile
back to tier 3 once the queue
is 2 x the threads or shorter
deoptimisation: a guard failed; the method is interpreted again,
and its profile keeps the trap count and a decompile count
both queues: the method with the highest event rate first; an entry idle 50 ms is dropped
